test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the compound interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 15600 at 20% p.a. for 2(1)/(4) years, the interest being compounded annually? [Give your answer correct to the nearest Rs.]
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 15600,

Rate per annum = 20% and

T = 2 years + 1/4 year

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + R / 100)T

**Calculations:**

The interest rate for 1st and 2nd year = 20%

Interest rate for (1 / 4) year = 20 x (1 / 4) = 5%

According to the question

⇒ A = 15600 × (120 / 100) × (120 / 100) × (105 / 100)

⇒ 15600 × (1.2) × (1.2) × (1.05)

⇒ 15600 × (1.512) = 23587.2

Compound interest = 23587.2 - 15600 = 7987.2 ~ 7987.

**Hence The interest being compounded annually is 7897.**
